children.text: Welcome to the official website of the Jade Palace, the revered heart of kung fu in the Valley of Peace. For generations, the Jade Palace has stood as a beacon of strength, wisdom, and harmony, training the greatest warriors in all of China. Founded by Grand Master Oogway, our halls have witnessed the rise of legends—heroes and masters whose stories inspire all who seek the path of kung fu.

Here, under the guidance of Master Shifu, students learn not only the art of combat but also the virtues of discipline, humility, and inner peace. Our mission is to preserve the ancient traditions of kung fu while nurturing the next generation of protectors and leaders.

Within these walls, the Furious Five—Tigress, Monkey, Mantis, Viper, and Crane—alongside many dedicated students, strive for excellence in both body and spirit. The Jade Palace is more than a school; it is a sanctuary for those devoted to mastering themselves and serving the greater good.
Explore our history, meet our masters, and discover the stories that shape the legacy of the Jade Palace. Whether you are a student, a visitor, or a seeker of wisdom, you are welcome here.
